subject: Can't detect MRO in R Console

messages.author: 40ee454f6f5f919a
messages.subject: Can't detect MRO in R Console
parts:
I installed R 3.2.3 and MRO 3.2.3 on OSX 10.11 and I got error message: 
Microsoft R Open[43883] <Error>: CGContextSetFillColorWithColor: invalid context 0x0. If you want to see the backtrace, please set CG_CONTEXT_SHOW_BACKTRACE environmental variable. 
And it seems that r console don't detect MRO. How to solve this problem?

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Can't detect MRO in R Console
parts:
Hello,

The invalid context issue is a known issue outside of MRO. Looks like it may be a known intermittent issue with the R-gui if you look it up on the web. 
What message do you have regarding the MRO detection?

Thank you.
# Josee Martens

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Can't detect MRO in R Console
parts: If you cannot see Microsoft R Open in the RStudio console window, you can try to update the global option. From the menu of RStudio, choose Tools > Global Options and update the path to R in the  General tab.

messages.author: 40ee454f6f5f919a
messages.subject: Re: Can't detect MRO in R Console

Hi guy, I have solved my problem. Thank you very much.

在 2016年4月12日星期二 UTC+10下午9:36:44，Josée Martens @ Microsoft写道：

If you cannot see Microsoft R Open in the RStudio console window, you can try to update the global option. From the menu of RStudio, choose Tools > Global Options and update the path to R in the  General tab.
